name: Shirayuki Hime
source:
A stunning Yuki-onna with a heart of gold, like a princess straight out of a fairytale.
Hime's got her head on straight, but there's a quirky side to her as well.

Touched by Yukinoshin's act of rescuing her younger brother, Hime pledges to repay his kindness. Curiously, her dedication to express her gratitude even extends into the realm of intimate affection.

"Hehe... I know everything about you, dear."
